body.text: NAB has confirmed it has been affected by an online banking outage. ( ABC News: Keana Naughton )
Link copied Share Share article Tell us about your experience.
National Australia Bank (NAB) is experiencing a digital outage across multiple platforms.
An announcement on its website said the outage was impacting internet banking and the NAB mobile app.
"We're aware that customers are also experiencing issues when contacting us via over the phone," NAB's website said.
"Our team is working to fix this as soon as possible. We apologise for the inconvenience."
NAB said no planned maintenance was scheduled.
One NAB customer said she received an alert on her mobile banking app which said: "We're sorry, the app isn't working at the moment. We'll have it back up and running as soon as we can."
